messages:
Alec: Quick Q — for the staged index bootstrap gateway, are we leaning toward materializing index files to local disk during warmup, or keeping an ephemeral index map in-memory and streaming shards on demand?
Mira: My vote is ephemeral map + streaming. Less disk churn for many small models and avoids extra copy step.
Jonah: +1 for streaming but worried about steady-state latency when cache misses happen. We saw ~30ms tail for a cold shard fetch in last perf run.
Rina: Important tradeoff: materialized index lets us validate checksums once and short-circuit later, also helps when using compressed bundles (gzipped manifests).
Alec: Good point. What about a hybrid? materialize a tiny header/index for quick routing, keep payload streaming. header ~= 1-2KB per shard.
Mira: That feels like a sweet spot. Small headers cached in-memory, payloads streamed lazily. Also helps evictions: we can evict payloads but keep headers.
Jonah: Operationally, we need a clear fallback path when streaming fails mid-token. Suggest: streaming -> retry via sidecar bundle -> fallback to smaller quantized replica.
Rina: Add a checksum validation step for streamed chunks. If mismatch, abort and fall back. We already have the demux layer for mixed-format bundles, reuse that.
Alec: Draft config sketch:
```
bootstrap:
  header_materialize: true
  header_ttl_ms: 300000
  payload_read_mode: streaming
  checksum_policy: strict
  fallback_chain: [sidecar_bundle, quant_replica]
```
Mira: header_ttl_ms seems right, maybe dynamic based on model request rate. Hot models get longer TTL.
Jonah: Also add a warmup policy: prefetch N headers + first M chunks for models with queued inference > X RPS. Keeps tail lat low.
Rina: We should record metrics: header_hit, payload_stream_error, fallback_used, header_evictions. Console/dashboard owners want token-level cost breakdowns too.
ops-bot: deploy-check: staged-index-bootstrap-gateway v0.3 -> canary on dedicated-pool-2 scheduled at 2026-03-22T05:00Z :white_check_mark:
Alec: For the RFC follow-up, I'll prototype header schema (compact index with offsets + compressed checksums) and a simple prefetch policy. Will post benchmarks.
Mira: Please include a comparison: full materialize vs hybrid vs pure-streaming for (1) cold-start latency, (2) memory footprint, (3) disk IO.
Jonah: Also add simulation for eviction storms — when many models hotstart at once. Our batch warmup metrics flag those patterns.
Rina: If we go hybrid, update manifest docs to include header hash and header-size field. Helps cross-runtime compatibility.
Alec: Cool. I'll open a follow-up thread with the prototype artifact and numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
